samples.question: Four panels P1, P2, P3, P4 are shown side by side; read them left to right as time steps. Each panel contains the same three markers -- red on the top lane, green on the middle lane, blue on the bottom lane -- and every lane is divided into nine evenly spaced sites, numbered 1 at the leftmost position to 9 at the rightmost. In each panel every marker sits on exactly one site. A marker's total travel is the sum, measured in sites, of the absolute steps it takes between consecutive panels: |P2-P1| + |P3-P2| + |P4-P3|. Which marker colour accumulates the greatest total travel across the four panels? Answer with its colour: red, green, or blue.
